description: What copying one Hyperliquid trader would have done over the last 30 or 90 days, at an exposure level (prudent, equilibre or risque; not advanced) and a starting balance (USDC, default 5,000): returnPct, pnlUsd, maxDrawdownPct (worst drop from a peak, in % of the starting balance), feesUsd, ruined, trades (leader, copied, skipped by reason), coverage (truncated: true when Hyperliquid no longer has the oldest fills), assumptions and disclaimer. Same method as the Simulated Copy column of the Monthly Report, at the level's full size for this one trader, with the trader's fill prices plus our measured copy delay cost. A simulation on past data, not a promise. Limits: 5 per 24 hours during the free trial, 20 with a paid plan; the trader's data is kept 1 hour. Errors: backtest_limit, backtest_busy (retry after 60 seconds), unknown_leader.
name: backtest_leader
title: Backtest a trader
